title: Lower Level Apartment in East
description:
Lower level apartment. Private entrance. Covered deck overlooking forest. Quiet residential neighborhood in East Nashville with little traffic. Large bathroom with walk-in shower. Washer and Dryer included. Walking distance to Shelby Bottoms and East Nashville Bars. 15 minutes from BNA & Opryland and 15 minutes from downtown Nashville. Parking spaces in front of the entrance.

The space
The apartment has a  large living room with couch, chair and 55” TV. Unit has fast wifi.  The bedroom accommodates up to 2 guests with king size bed.

Guest access
Door from covered deck into the unit with electronic keypad entrance. Code will be sent prior to check-in.

Other things to note
No parties, please. The unit is the lower level of a larger house. No access between the two.
